subject: design/feature-draft-local-git
statement: Authors and stage skills edit markdown working files on the draft branch, close to today's templates, and one deterministic compiler turns them into memory records (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-3`, `#D-11`). Every reader of an open draft — readiness, the pull request's packet, the in-flight notice — calls the same compiler in process and writes nothing.
